identity.title: Pokémon the Series: Kanto and Orange Islands - Limited Edition Collection

leadText:
The Pokémon the Series: Kanto and Orange Islands - Limited Edition Collection is a Region 4 DVD set released by in Australia on March 2, 2016, and in New Zealand on March 16, 2016. This DVD set is also referred to as the Pokémon Adventures in Kanto and the Orange Islands Collector's Set in promotional material. It contains four individual DVD cases with uniform covers that each contain a number of discs. Overall, the set includes 22 discs with 173 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is BHE6366. The DVDs don't include English closed captioning.

It contains all of the regular dubbed episodes of that take place in Kanto or the Orange Islands, with the exceptions of Holiday Hi-Jynx, Stage Fight!, The Mandarin Island Miss Match (which all featured in its original design), and the "lost episode" Beauty and the Beach. It contains episodes from Indigo League, Adventures in the Orange Islands, The Johto Journeys, Advanced Battle, and Battle Frontier. In Region 4 releases, the episodes are ordered and separated according to standard seasons, rather than by Viz Media season.
